title: Podcast Channel
description: A document containing metadata about a podcast channel

copyright.description: The copyright policy applied to this podcast channel represented as HTML

language.description: An BCP 47 (or RFC 1766) language tag describing the primary language of this channel

itunes.description: iTunes-specific attributes for this podcast channel

block.description: iTunes-specific flag to block the podcast from publishing. See https://help.apple.com/itc/podcasts_connect/#/itcb54353390 for more information.

owner.description: iTunes-specific ownership information. See https://help.apple.com/itc/podcasts_connect/#/itcb54353390 for more detail.

name.description: The name of the owner of this podcast channel

email.description: An RFC6531-compliant email address associated with the owner of this podcast channel

channelType.description: The type of podcast this channel describes

rssFeeds.description: Links to the RSS feeds used for this podcast channel

allowedCountries.description: A list of ISO 3166 country codes this podcast channel should be restricted to. If not present, there are no assumed restrictions. Ex: 'us'

feedEpisodeCount.description: Used by CDS clients to limit how many episodes are displayed in a podcast feed. If this field is not present on a document (ie. a `null` value), it is understood that ALL episodes should be displayed.
